limitations: Strictly positive trajectories tending to extinction; explicitly includes the open region 0<u(0)<M.
Only S=M and Q=A(1+M)/2, with A>0, 0<M<1 and A != 1+M.
Nonlinear amplitude and phase constants depend on the trajectory; no classification of other basins.
Physical time theta=rKt; accelerated polynomial time has different asymptotics.
Scientific priority remains subject to independent review and broader literature coverage.
title: Resonant extinction slip at a double cancellation in a strong-Allee Holling–Tanner flow
